about: The spec of screens M02 to M14, hand-authored from PLAN_admin_seed_v01.md section 14 (phase C part 1, 23 Sep 2026). W12, 5 Oct 2026 (the Split page picks confirmed): three screens are built, M03 the staff view of a client, M07 the health page and M10 the config screen; the other ten are dropped with a pointer each (M08 to the logic panel's L08; M12 and M14 into M03).

screens.title: People: search and list
screens.purpose: Search and list every person in the seed, filtered by state, tier, path, adviser, flags, DIFM prospect or topup. Opens a person's full record.
screens.zoho_instead: {I14} CRM list views over the Contact and its mirrored fields; assign adviser is the Contact owner (mastered in {I14}; the app reads it, W12, 7 Oct 2026); export is the CRM's (W12, 5 Oct 2026).

checks: No user-facing copy; nothing to review.

reason: dropped: moved out of the admin panel, see the pointer (W12, 5 Oct 2026)

v02.pointer: {I14} CRM list views over the Contact and its mirrored fields; assign adviser is the Contact owner (mastered in {I14}; the app reads it, W12, 7 Oct 2026); export is the CRM's (W12, 5 Oct 2026).

fields: filters by state, tier, path, adviser, flags, DIFM prospect, topup
dev: The app must expose a people list endpoint with server-side filters for state, tier, path, adviser, flags, DIFM prospect and topup, and pagination for 3,000-plus rows.
Assign adviser and export list are mock; a real build wires them to the adviser roster and a CSV or CRM sync job.

screens.title: Staff view of a client
screens.purpose: The admin screen over client data, the one place staff write into the app: find a person by phone, open their own screens in staff mode (the record with its source and completion badges, the data screens, the plan, the vault), read-only by seat scope, edit on behalf for ops with the engine re-run, the actions (deletion done, DIFM tier, refund flag, the subscription actions, suspend, force re-run), an audit row per action, a staff allowlist with seats on the sign-in.

writes.action: edit inputs on behalf (opens the client's screen in staff mode, re-runs the engine)
subscription: refund, cancel, extend or comp (through {I09}; the Deal and the billing state follow)
suspend an account (to be decided: when an account is suspended)
set the DIFM tier and enter data on behalf (from M12)
staff allowlist: add a seat, revoke (from M14); credentials and MFA are {I14}'s

screens.zoho_instead: The Contact's mirrors (onboarding percent, statuses, source completeness) serve every seat that does not need the numbers; the Contact's admin panel link opens this view. The record itself never lives in {I14} (W12).

checks: No user-facing copy; nothing to review.

reason: to be decided: when an account is suspended (the action exists; the rule does not)
open until the brief is accepted (W12, 5 Oct 2026)

causes: W12, 5 Oct 2026 (the staff view; M12 and M14 fold in)
W12, 7 Oct 2026 (the six answers: the subscription actions, suspend, the devices tab, the owner in {I14}, sign-in with {I14})

fields: the client's screens in staff mode: the record with source and completion badges, the data screens, the plan, the vault
subscriptions, with refund, cancel, extend and comp
the staff allowlist with seats (principal officer)
dev: The app must expose a single person read endpoint joining every table by person_id, plus the events feed for the timeline.

Staff mode: the app serves its own client screens to an allowlisted staff account with a seat and a scope (advisers and the call centre their own clients); every write goes through the same services as the client's own actions and appends an audit row (W12, 5 Oct 2026).
On-behalf edits, force re-run, refund flag, the subscription actions, suspend, the DIFM tier and deletion handling are mock here; a real build wires each to its own service call.
The staff allowlist with seats: create, assign a seat, revoke. Sign-in is with the {I14} account, MFA in {I14}; the allowlist maps each {I14} user to a seat (W12, 7 Oct 2026; gap G21 closed).

Refund, cancel, extend or comp are actions here for the support seat, through {I09} (W12, 7 Oct 2026; gap G19 closed). Suspend is an action here for ops; to be decided: when an account is suspended (gap G20). Devices and sessions is a tab of web sessions only (W12, 7 Oct 2026; gap G24 closed). The adviser owner is the Contact owner in {I14}; the app reads it; no reassign here (W12, 7 Oct 2026).

Content and copy are not here; they live in {I15}.
